name: fraction_role
description: Identify whether a specified fraction component is the numerator or denominator, with matched component-copy control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a,b=random.sample(range(2,99),2);top=i%2==0;x=a if top else b
 items.append({'prompt':f'In the fraction {a}/{b}, the number {x} is the', 'answer':' '+('numerator' if top else 'denominator')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'In the fraction {a}/{b}, the number {x} is copied here:', 'answer':' '+str(x)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
